answer: A farm of 370 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in nadir, queued in vertex, and delta publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 89 identities per epoch. A farm of 1481 identities would post 1872 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
